decisions.decision: Add runtime subtree without editing any accepted canonical file or accepted generator/checker.
decisions.downstream_consequences: Use the scoped runtime checker for the additive graph, retaining older sealed evidence.
decisions.rationale: Transport optimization is not a replacement scientific/publication contract.
decisions.reversibility: Canonical view remains independently available; future delivery versions require separate engineering authorization.

alternatives_considered: D source-only shards including large D4
decisions.decision: ABC source/design shards; D source/frozen-specification shards; four smaller state lists canonical-backed.
decisions.downstream_consequences: Select an explicit route, then an existing state. No Cartesian-product inference.
decisions.rationale: Existing metadata defines these keys exactly; D4 group diagnostics should not load with D0.
decisions.reversibility: Only routing and storage organization; state records and IDs remain canonical.

decisions.decision: Provide raw JSON and deterministic binary gzip alternatives; report both sizes without assuming CDN behavior.
decisions.downstream_consequences: Validate hosting Content-Encoding behavior; never double-decompress a .gz asset.
decisions.rationale: Static delivery can reduce transfers while retaining raw fallback representation and exact byte equality.
decisions.reversibility: Alternate encodings carry identical logical records; future client may choose either once.

alternatives_considered: Duplicate/decode exact resources for ordinary charts (rejected)
decisions.decision: Preserve full records, exact references, guards/defaults/coverage, 444 additional public states, zero internal reachability and two CARD_ONLY methods.
decisions.downstream_consequences: Use prepared display fields; pooled exact integer strings stay strings with zero client scientific arithmetic.
decisions.rationale: Accepted visibility and numerical semantics are authoritative; lazy exact resources already exist.
decisions.reversibility: No scientific change; accepted records remain the authority.
